basic_profile.bio: I'm a freshman at UC Davis currently majoring in math, but I'm considering a switch to a pre-med track. I'm originally from San Francisco and moved to Davis for school. I love discussing historical events, especially the Titanic, and enjoy late-night browsing when I'm not swamped with coursework. I also like getting advice from older generations, hence my recent visits to AskMenOver30. I'm single, focusing on my studies, and often online during the late evenings.
